body.heading: Where in the world is Libya?
paragraphs: Libya is a country in Northern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Libya is Tripoli.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Libya is Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Libya is the Libyan dinar.

body.heading: How big is Libya?
paragraphs: Libya covers about 1,760,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Madagascar.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Leptis Magna is one of the best-preserved Roman cities anywhere — marble streets, a huge theatre and triumphal arches standing by the Mediterranean Sea.
Ghadames is a desert oasis town of whitewashed mud-brick houses and covered lanes, called the 'pearl of the desert' and protected by UNESCO.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Libya on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Libya in one breath: a country in Northern Africa, capital Tripoli, where people speak Arabic and pay with the Libyan dinar.
